name: Group Work Day
description: Teams pick roles, then check off a shared to-do list, live progress on the projector. Swap in your own tasks for any work day.

intro.message:
GROUP WORK DAY!

You're about to be split into groups, and everyone picks a job: Facilitator keeps the talk moving, Recorder writes things down, Timekeeper watches the clock.

Every group has the same checklist on their devices, check tasks off as your group finishes them, and watch the progress board up here.

worktime.prompt: Work through today's tasks with your group. Tagged tasks belong to a role, but the whole group backs each other up.
items: Introduce yourselves and agree on a team name

items.text: Facilitator: make sure everyone has said their name and one interest

items: Find three things everyone in your group has in common (going to this school doesn't count)

items.text: Recorder: write your group's three common things where everyone can see them

items: Agree on one dream field trip, a destination and the reason

items.text: Timekeeper: give a two-minutes-left warning before the pitch planning ends

items: Plan a 30-second pitch for your field trip and pick who delivers it
Final check: mark this when every member has spoken at least twice

end.message: That's Group Work Day! Swap in your own tasks and roles for any lab, stations, or project session.
